corrections.reason: The Celtic Wiki's 1888 page lists this friendly under June; the import collapsed the month to May.
Listed under June on the same page; month collapsed to May.
Wikipedia's 1888-89 season page dates Celtic 3-4 Clyde 23 June 1888; the import had May (Wikipedia is the tiebreak).
Scottish Cup 1st round v Shettleston was 1 September 1888 (Wikipedia, London Hearts, Fitbastats); the import had 1 August, the day of the Exhibition Cup tie v Abercorn.
Wikipedia's season page: 3 September 1888, Whitefield 1-5 Celtic (Wikipedia is the tiebreak on the score).
Glasgow Exhibition Cup final v Cowlairs was 6 September 1888.
Friendly v Dumbarton Athletic was 8 September 1888.
Friendly at Dumbarton was 15 September 1888 (listed under September).
Scottish Cup 2nd round, Celtic 8-0 Cowlairs, 22 September 1888 (Wikipedia, London Hearts, The Celtic Wiki).

Tennis Borussia Berlin 3-0 FC St. Pauli was played on 8 May 1976 (Wikipedia's TeBe 1975-76 season page; TeBe played at Münster on 1 May). The DFB data centre prints 1 May for both St. Pauli matches, which cannot be.
Hapoel Beit She'an 2-3 Beitar Jerusalem is not a Hapoel Tel Aviv match; it reached the club's archive by mistake.

No State Cup tie Hapoel Tel Aviv 2-1 Maccabi Petah Tikva on 28 May 1949 exists: the 1949-51 cup meetings were 3-1 and 2-0 (Maccabi Avshalom), and the league opened that day (Hapoel Tel Aviv 2-0 Hapoel Rishon LeZion).
